verses.en: Now these are the kings of the land, which the children of Israel smote, and possessed their land on the other side Jordan toward the rising of the sun, from the river Arnon unto mount Hermon, and all the plain on the east:
verses.pt: Estes são os reis da terra que os filhos de Israel feriram, e cuja terra possuíram da outra parte do Jordão ao oriente, desde o ribeiro de Arnom até o monte Hermom, e toda a planície oriental:
verses.en_web: Now these are the kings of the land, whom the children of Israel struck, and possessed their land beyond the Jordan toward the sunrise, from the valley of the Arnon to Mount Hermon, and all the Arabah eastward:
verses.en_bbe: Now these are the kings of the land whom the children of Israel overcame, taking as their heritage their land on the east side of Jordan, from the valley of the Arnon to Mount Hermon, and all the Arabah to the east:

verses.en: Sihon king of the Amorites, who dwelt in Heshbon, and ruled from Aroer, which is upon the bank of the river Arnon, and from the middle of the river, and from half Gilead, even unto the river Jabbok, which is the border of the children of Ammon;
verses.pt: Seom rei dos amorreus, que habitava em Hesbom, e senhoreava desde Aroer, que está à beira do ribeiro de Arnom, e desde em meio do ribeiro, e a metade de Gileade, até o ribeiro Jaboque, o termo dos filhos de Amom;
verses.en_web: Sihon king of the Amorites, who lived in Heshbon, and ruled from Aroer, which is on the edge of the valley of the Arnon, and the middle of the valley, and half Gilead, even to the river Jabbok, the border of the children of Ammon;
verses.en_bbe: Sihon, king of the Amorites, who was living in Heshbon, ruling from Aroer, which is on the edge of the valley of the Arnon, and the town in the middle of the valley, and half Gilead, as far as the river Jabbok, the limits of the children of Ammon;

verses.en: And from the plain to the sea of Chinneroth on the east, and unto the sea of the plain, even the salt sea on the east, the way to Beth-jeshimoth; and from the south, under Ashdoth-pisgah:
verses.pt: E desde a campina até o mar de Quinerete, ao oriente; e até o mar da planície, o mar Salgado, ao oriente, pelo caminho de Bete-Jesimote; e desde o sul debaixo das encostas do Pisga.
verses.en_web: and the Arabah to the sea of Chinneroth, eastward, and to the sea of the Arabah, even the Salt Sea, eastward, the way to Beth Jeshimoth; and on the south, under the slopes of Pisgah:
verses.en_bbe: And the Arabah to the sea of Chinneroth, to the east, and to the sea of the Arabah, that is the Salt Sea, to the east, the way to Beth-jeshimoth; and on the south, under the slopes of Pisgah:

verses.en: And the coast of Og king of Bashan, which was of the remnant of the giants, that dwelt at Ashtaroth and at Edrei,
verses.pt: E os termos de Ogue rei de Basã, que havia restado dos refains, o qual habitava em Astarote e em Edrei,
verses.en_web: and the border of Og king of Bashan, of the remnant of the Rephaim, who lived at Ashtaroth and at Edrei,
verses.en_bbe: And the land of Og, king of Bashan, of the rest of the Rephaim, who was living at Ashtaroth and at Edrei,

verses.en: And reigned in mount Hermon, and in Salcah, and in all Bashan, unto the border of the Geshurites and the Maachathites, and half Gilead, the border of Sihon king of Heshbon.
verses.pt: E senhoreava no monte de Hermom, e em Salcá, e em todo Basã até os termos de Gessuri e dos maacatitas, e a metade de Gileade, termo de Seom rei de Hesbom.
verses.en_web: and ruled in Mount Hermon, and in Salecah, and in all Bashan, to the border of the Geshurites and the Maacathites, and half Gilead, the border of Sihon king of Heshbon.
verses.en_bbe: Ruling in the mountain of Hermon, and in Salecah, and in all Bashan, as far as the limits of the Geshurites and the Maacathites, and half Gilead, to the land of Sihon, king of Heshbon.

verses.en: Them did Moses the servant of the LORD and the children of Israel smite: and Moses the servant of the LORD gave it for a possession unto the Reubenites, and the Gadites, and the half tribe of Manasseh.
verses.pt: A estes feriram Moisés servo do SENHOR e os filhos de Israel; e Moisés servo do SENHOR deu aquela terra em possessão aos rubenitas, gaditas, e à meia tribo de Manassés.
verses.en_web: Moses the servant of Yahweh and the children of Israel struck them. Moses the servant of Yahweh gave it for a possession to the Reubenites, and the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh.
verses.en_bbe: Moses, the servant of the Lord, and the children of Israel overcame them; and Moses, the servant of the Lord, gave their land for a heritage to the Reubenites, and the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh.

verses.en: And these are the kings of the country which Joshua and the children of Israel smote on this side Jordan on the west, from Baal-gad in the valley of Lebanon even unto the mount Halak, that goeth up to Seir; which Joshua gave unto the tribes of Israel for a possession according to their divisions;
verses.pt: E estes são os reis da terra que feriu Josué com os filhos de Israel, desta parte do Jordão ao ocidente, desde Baal-Gade na planície do Líbano até o monte de Halaque que sobe a Seir; a qual terra deu Josué em possessão às tribos de Israel,
verses.en_web: These are the kings of the land whom Joshua and the children of Israel struck beyond the Jordan westward, from Baal Gad in the valley of Lebanon even to Mount Halak, that goes up to Seir. Joshua gave it to the tribes of Israel for a possession according to their divisions;
verses.en_bbe: And these are the kings of the land whom Joshua and the children of Israel overcame on the west side of Jordan, from Baal-gad in the valley of Lebanon to Mount Halak, which goes up to Seir; and Joshua gave the land to the tribes of Israel for a heritage, in keeping with their divisions;

verses.en: In the mountains, and in the valleys, and in the plains, and in the springs, and in the wilderness, and in the south country; the Hittites, the Amorites, and the Canaanites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites:
verses.pt: Em montes e em vales, em planícies e em encostas, ao deserto e ao sul; os heteus, e os amorreus, e os cananeus, e os ferezeus, e os heveus, e os jebuseus.
verses.en_web: in the hill country, and in the lowland, and in the Arabah, and in the slopes, and in the wilderness, and in the South; the Hittite, the Amorite, and the Canaanite, the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite:
verses.en_bbe: In the hill-country, and in the lowland, and in the Arabah, and on the mountain slopes, and in the waste land, and in the South; the Hittites, the Amorites, and the Canaanites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites.

verses.en: The king of Jericho, one; the king of Ai, which is beside Bethel, one;
verses.pt: O rei de Jericó, um: o rei de Ai, que está ao lado de Betel, outro:
verses.en_web: the king of Jericho, one; the king of Ai, which is beside Bethel, one;
verses.en_bbe: The king of Jericho, one; the king of Ai, which is near Beth-el, one;

verses.en: The king of Jerusalem, one; the king of Hebron, one;
verses.pt: O rei de Jerusalém, outro: o rei de Hebrom, outro:
verses.en_web: the king of Jerusalem, one; the king of Hebron, one;
verses.en_bbe: The king of Jerusalem, one; the king of Hebron, one;

verses.en: The king of Jarmuth, one; the king of Lachish, one;
verses.pt: O rei de Jarmute, outro: o rei de Laquis, outro:
verses.en_web: the king of Jarmuth, one; the king of Lachish, one;
verses.en_bbe: The king of Jarmuth, one; the king of Lachish, one;

verses.en: The king of Eglon, one; the king of Gezer, one;
verses.pt: O rei de Eglom, outro: o rei de Gezer, outro:
verses.en_web: the king of Eglon, one; the king of Gezer, one;
verses.en_bbe: The king of Eglon, one; the king of Gezer, one;

verses.en: The king of Debir, one; the king of Geder, one;
verses.pt: O rei de Debir, outro: o rei de Geder, outro:
verses.en_web: the king of Debir, one; the king of Geder, one;
verses.en_bbe: The king of Debir, one; the king of Geder, one;

verses.en: The king of Hormah, one; the king of Arad, one;
verses.pt: O rei de Hormá, outro: o rei de Arade, outro:
verses.en_web: the king of Hormah, one; the king of Arad, one;
verses.en_bbe: The king of Hormah, one; the king of Arad, one;

verses.en: The king of Libnah, one; the king of Adullam, one;
verses.pt: O rei de Libna, outro: o rei de Adulão, outro:
verses.en_web: the king of Libnah, one; the king of Adullam, one;
verses.en_bbe: The king of Libnah, one; the king of Adullam, one;

verses.en: The king of Makkedah, one; the king of Bethel, one;
verses.pt: O rei de Maquedá, outro: o rei de Betel, outro:
verses.en_web: the king of Makkedah, one; the king of Bethel, one;
verses.en_bbe: The king of Makkedah, one; the king of Beth-el, one;

verses.en: The king of Tappuah, one; the king of Hepher, one;
verses.pt: O rei de Tapua, outro: o rei de Héfer, outro:
verses.en_web: the king of Tappuah, one; the king of Hepher, one;
verses.en_bbe: The king of Tappuah, one; the king of Hepher, one;

verses.en: The king of Aphek, one; the king of Lasharon, one;
verses.pt: O rei de Afeque, outro: o rei de Lasarom, outro:
verses.en_web: the king of Aphek, one; the king of Lassharon, one;
verses.en_bbe: The king of Aphek, one; the king of Lassharon, one;

verses.en: The king of Madon, one; the king of Hazor, one;
verses.pt: O rei de Madom, outro: o rei de Hazor, outro:
verses.en_web: the king of Madon, one; the king of Hazor, one;
verses.en_bbe: The king of Madon, one; the king of Hazor, one;

verses.en: The king of Shimron-meron, one; the king of Achshaph, one;
verses.pt: O rei de Sinrom-Merom, outro: o rei de Acsafe, outro:
verses.en_web: the king of Shimron Meron, one; the king of Achshaph, one;
verses.en_bbe: The king of Shimron-meron, one; the king of Achshaph, one;

verses.en: The king of Taanach, one; the king of Megiddo, one;
verses.pt: O rei de Taanaque, outro: o rei de Megido, outro:
verses.en_web: the king of Taanach, one; the king of Megiddo, one;
verses.en_bbe: The king of Taanach, one; the king of Megiddo, one;

verses.en: The king of Kedesh, one; the king of Jokneam of Carmel, one;
verses.pt: O rei de Quedes, outro: o rei de Jocneão do Carmelo, outro:
verses.en_web: the king of Kedesh, one; the king of Jokneam in Carmel, one;
verses.en_bbe: The king of Kedesh, one; the king of Jokneam in Carmel, one;

verses.en: The king of Dor in the coast of Dor, one; the king of the nations of Gilgal, one;
verses.pt: O rei de Dor, da província de Dor, outro; o rei de nações em Gilgal, outro:
verses.en_web: the king of Dor in the height of Dor, one; the king of Goiim in Gilgal, one;
verses.en_bbe: The king of Dor on the hill of Dor, one; the king of Goiim in Gilgal, one;

verses.en: The king of Tirzah, one: all the kings thirty and one.
verses.pt: O rei de Tirsa, outro: trinta e um reis ao todo.
verses.en_web: the king of Tirzah, one: all the kings thirty-one.
verses.en_bbe: The king of Tirzah, one; all the kings together were thirty-one.
